attempts.summary: Deployed inventory-api as an OpenRC-managed service on Alpine node1 with OOM protection (start-stop-daemon --oom-score-adj -1000). Verified it keeps serving through a real out-of-memory event by driving the system OOM with an unprotected memory-hog process, which the kernel OOM-killer selected and killed instead of inventory-api. Completed the mandatory single-node reboot/recovery protocol with proof of a changed boot identity and full post-restart service health.
